name: Arlecchino

abilities.name: Invitation to a Beheading

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, dashing toward a nearby opponent and cleaving once.
Continuously holding this button will cause Arlecchino to consume Stamina and engage in up to 5s of high-speed movement.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description:
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
Masque of the Red Death
When Arlecchino has a Bond of Life equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, she will enter the "Masque of the Red Death" state, where her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to deal Pyro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
When in the "Masque of the Red Death" state, Arlecchino's Normal Attacks will deal extra DMG to opponents on hit that scales off her ATK multiplied by a certain ratio of her current Bond of Life percentage. This will consume 7.5% of said current Bond of Life. Her Bond of Life can be consumed this way every 0.03s. When her Bond of Life is consumed in this manner, All Is Ash's CD will decrease by 0.8s.

_curatorNotes: ↻ MASQUE'S PYRO INFUSION AUTHORED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche) as `infusion: pyro` on this ability — the Durin dark-commit shape. gcsim `attack.go` / `charge.go` / `plunge.go` set `ai.Element = Pyro` (with IgnoreInfusion) on every N, CA and plunge hit while `masque-of-the-red-death` is active, i.e. while her Bond of Life is ≥ 30% of Max HP. Bond of Life is still untracked, so the infusion is drawn ALWAYS ON: a played Arlecchino sits in Masque for essentially her whole field time, and before this every swing applied NOTHING (measured `Arlecchino E N1 N2 N3 C Q` → four Pyro applications, none from the six swings or the CA) — which also left her authored `chargedIcdWindow` unreachable. The over-claim is the opening swings before the first directive is absorbed; caveated. The BoL-scaled FlatDmg stays out of scope (damage magnitude). The generator's old `manual` Masque damage entry stays removed.

N4 has two hitmarks (24, 35); swap reflects the last hitmark per recipe convention. attackHitlagHaltFrame[3] = {0, 0} with attackDefHalt[3] = {true, false} — the second sub-hit cannot be defense-halted.

N6 ActionCharge = 55 is set explicitly in gcsim — included even though the recipe key-set table omits C on the final hit. Other final-hit polearm chars (Hu Tao) have ActionCharge = 500 sentinel and omit; arlecchino is real.

Charged-attack `early_cancel` param in gcsim allows cancelling the CA dash with D/J before hitmark (returns 13-windup frames), with a 12f post-N windup discount. Not modeled — schema has no per-cancel-action variant.
Charged-attack chargeFrames includes ActionCharge = 53 (CA-into-CA cancel) — omitted per recipe key-set rule for charged attacks (no C key).

High plunge variants exist in gcsim (highPlungeFrames distinct from low) but are not represented per recipe. plungeFrames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFrames. ActionDash not set on lowPlungeFrames — D omitted per recipe rule. ActionCharge = 69 set on lowPlungeFrames — omitted per recipe key-set rule (no C on plunges).
gcsim restricts plunge to AirborneXianyun-launched only — sim limitation, not in-game.

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.
abilities.caveat: Her attacks are drawn as Pyro throughout, as if Masque of the Red Death were always active. In game they stay Physical until her Bond of Life reaches 30% of her Max HP.

abilities.name: All Is Ash
abilities.description:
Summons forth Balemoon Bloodfire, dealing Pyro DMG to multiple nearby opponents and performing a dash-cleave against one of them, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the aforementioned attack will have a Blood-Debt Directive applied to them.

Blood-Debt Directive
·Lasts 30s. Every 5s, it will deal 1 instance of Pyro DMG to the opponent. Max 2 instances. This DMG will be considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Arlecchino uses a Charged Attack or her Elemental Burst, Balemoon Rising, she will absorb and clear nearby Blood-Debt Directives. Each Directive absorbed grants her a Bond of Life worth 65% of her Max HP.
·The maximum value of the Bond of Life she can be granted through Blood-Debt Directives within 35s after using her Elemental Skill is 145% of her Max HP. Using the Elemental Skill again during this duration will restart the count on duration and the limit on the value of Bond of Life she may gain from Blood-Debt Directives.
_curatorNotes: Behavior changed from `persistent` to `instant` per recipe; original generator stub had `behavior: "persistent"` with `duration: 30` and `tags: ["summon"]` — all removed. Blood-Debt Directives are enemy-attached debuffs (similar to Hu Tao Blood Blossom or Mona Omen), not caster-side stance or summon entities. Directives have a 30s lifetime and tick every 5s for up to 2 instances of skillSigil DMG (skillSigil[8] = 0.5406 talent 9). Reviewer to model directives once schema supports enemy-attached debuffs with periodic damage callbacks.

Skill ticks: Spike hit at frame 17 (mult skillSpike[talent], skillSpike[8] = 0.25228), Final cleave hit at frame 38 (mult skillFinal[talent], skillFinal[8] = 2.27052). Both Pyro. Particle generation: 5 Pyro particles via particleCB on cleave hit, 0.3s ICD.

BoL economy on cast: a 35s `directiveLimitKey` window opens at finalHitmark+1, capping BoL gain to 1.45 × MaxHP (gcsim skillDebtMax). Directives absorbed via CA or Q grant 0.65 × MaxHP each (1.30 with A1 upgrade after 5s, or initialDirectiveLevel = 2 with C2). Recasting E within the 35s window resets the counter. Not authored — schema has no BoL-grant or directive-absorb encoder.
Skill cooldown 30s with 16-frame delay (gcsim `c.SetCDWithDelay(action.ActionSkill, 30*60, 16)`).

✅ `icdGate` { timer 600, every 3 } authored 2026-09-17 (cast-icd-gate round; read off gcsim's group tables via the frames audit's §4b, ⛔ never inferred from an applied count). `ICDGroupArlecchinoElementalArt` (600f, 1-0-0 sequence): the Spike (+17) and the Blood-Debt Directive ticks (+338, +638) share it; the Cleave (+38) is `ICDTagNone` in gcsim and carries an entry-level `noICD` — it applies always and spends no slot. Standard drew 17/338✗/638 and dropped the Cleave; gcsim lands 17, 38, 638 and suppresses 338, and so do we now.

abilities.name: Balemoon Rising
abilities.description: Arlecchino's great wing of Balemoon Bloodfire beats as she absorbs and clears Blood-Debt Directives around her. She deals AoE Pyro DMG before clearing the CD of All Is Ash and healing herself. The healing is based on her Bond of Life value and ATK.
_curatorNotes: Energy cost reads as 60 in data_gen.textproto, but gcsim only `c.ConsumeEnergy(12)` on cast. Likely a built-in 80% energy refund or sim convention; in-game burst window confirms 60 to fill but consumption may differ. Authored as 60 (the standard energy bar size); reviewer to verify in-game.

Burst absorbs nearby Blood-Debt Directives at frame 22 (gcsim QueueCharTask(c.absorbDirectives, 22)), granting BoL per directive (see skill _curatorNotes). All Is Ash CD is reset at frame 107. Burst hit lands at frame 110 with mult burst[talent] (burst[8] = 6.2968 talent 9).
Burst FlatDmg += c6Amount() = TotalAtk × 7.0 × (CurrentHPDebt / MaxHP) at hitmark — BoL-scaling buff (Cons ≥ 6 only), not authored. Schema has no BoL-runtime-scaling encoder.

Self-heal authored 2026-07-12 as an onCast(burst) heal, target 'self'. gcsim burst.go balemoonRisingHeal (QueueCharTask at frame 123): amt = 1.5 × CurrentHPDebt + 1.5 × TotalAtk. The ReceiveHeal filter in arlecchino.go (lines 83-88) returns 0 for any healing whose Caller≠self or Message≠'Balemoon Rising (Heal)' — she is un-healable by anyone else (Blood-Debt identity). Only the ATK portion is authored: scaling 150, stat atk (sidecar burst 'Amount of HP Restored' = '150.0% Bond of Life+150.0% ATK', constant across talent levels; gcsim 1.5×TotalAtk). The 1.5 × CurrentHPDebt (150% of current Bond of Life) portion is NOT modeled — Bond of Life is not a ScalingStat and the planner doesn't track HP debt at runtime; flagged in the ability caveat.
Burst CD 15s with 0-frame delay; cooldownStartDelay omitted per recipe.
C4 reduces this burst's CD by 2s and grants 15 energy on each successful directive absorb (10s ICD). Not authored — schema has no `cooldownReduction` or `addEnergy` effect type.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — and the caveat's own middle clause is false about the screen. It says "Shown as the 150% ATK portion only" — but nothing is shown: a `heal` effect reaches no planner surface (no heal lane, no heal row, and the onCast trigger keeps it out of the chip strip too). Sentence 1 is a kit fact about who can heal her, which the tool never depicts either way; sentence 2 is a scaling magnitude with no bar to print it on, and Bond of Life is on the standing out-of-scope list. ⚠️ Worth noting the caveat reads as if the planner displays a heal figure it does not display. Category: invisible-omission.

✅ `cdReset` authored 2026-09-17 (small-fix bundle): "clearing the CD of All Is Ash" — gcsim burst.go `c.ResetActionCooldown(action.ActionSkill)`. It could not be authored before because the character cdReset walk skipped `char.abilities` (only passives and constellations were read), so a burst-hosted reset fired nothing; Freminet's had been authored into that gap. The BoL clear and the heal's Bond scaling are unchanged.

passives.name: Agony Alone May Be Repaid
passives.description:
Blood-Debt Directives have the following characteristics:
·Arlecchino will be granted a Bond of Life worth 130% of her Max HP when an opponent to which she herself applied a Directive is defeated.
·5s after a Directive is applied, it will be upgraded to a Blood-Debt Due. When absorbed, it will instead grant Arlecchino a Bond of Life worth 130%.
A Bond of Life created in the aforementioned ways cannot exceed the original limit on the value of Bonds of Life obtained through All Is Ash.
_curatorNotes: Two parts, both BoL-economy: (a) on-kill of a directive-marked enemy → BoL = 1.30 × MaxHP (gcsim a1OnKill, capped by 35s skillDebtMax window); (b) directives upgrade from level 1 → 2 (Blood-Debt Due) 5s after application (gcsim a1Upgrade, raises absorb scaling from 0.65 → 1.30 × MaxHP). Likely trigger types: `onTargetDied` (filtered to directive-marked enemies) and a periodic `5s after directive applied` upgrade. Schema has neither a BoL-grant encoder nor an `onTargetDied` trigger type. Not authored.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't model Bond of Life, and this passive only changes how much of it Arlecchino gains.

passives.name: Strength Alone Can Defend
passives.description: Arlecchino gains 1% All Elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK she has in excess of 1,000. The maximum RES increase she can gain this way for each is 20%.
_curatorNotes: Authored 2026-05-09 against the new allElementalRes / physicalRes stats. Value form is `unknown` because the planner doesn't track Arlecchino's ATK at runtime. gcsim asc.go comments `Resistances are not implemented` so no in-sim verification is possible; semantics taken from in-game text. The two effects render side-by-side as permanent self-buffs on the chip list.

constellations.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Mine to Bear..."
constellations.description: Masque of the Red Death is further enhanced, the value of the increase is 100%. Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death.
_curatorNotes: C1 increases the Masque ATK multiplier by +1.0 (gcsim cons.go bondBonus: `c1Bonus = 1.0` added to masque[talent]). The Masque damage itself is not authored due to BoL-runtime scaling — C1's modifier inherits that gap. Interruption resistance not modeled per recipe (no schema encoder).

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't model Bond of Life, which this constellation's damage bonus depends on.

constellations.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
constellations.caveat: The RES bars are drawn on every Burst and Charged Attack; in game they only appear when a Blood-Debt Due was actually absorbed, which needs a directive left by All Is Ash.
constellations.description:
Blood-Debt Directives are now already Blood-Debt Due when first applied.
When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Agony Alone May Be Repaid."
_curatorNotes: Inherited `trigger: "manual"` damage skeleton. Likely trigger: `onAbsorbDirective` (no equivalent schema trigger type). gcsim cons.go c2OnAbsorbDue: 9.00 × ATK Pyro AoE at frame 50 after absorb, 10s ICD via c2IcdKey. Skeleton's `scaling: 900` matches gcsim mult × 100; verify before promoting to onCast/onHit equivalent.
C2 additionally sets `initialDirectiveLevel = 2` (requires A1 ascension), so directives apply as Blood-Debt Due immediately rather than after the 5s upgrade. BoL-economy effect; not authored.

C2 +20% allElementalRes + physicalRes (15s, 10s ICD) — stats now exist (added 2026-05-09). Trigger is the absorb event, which the schema doesn't model; not authored to avoid over-firing on every Q regardless of whether an absorb actually happened. When a `onAbsorbDirective` trigger primitive lands, author as two self buffs (allElementalRes + physicalRes, value: 20, target: self, duration: 15, procCooldown: 10).

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C2 "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..." — effects[0] (damage atk 900 pyro) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/arlecchino/skill.go:143-169` — `absorbDirectives()` fires `c2OnAbsorbDue()` for each enemy whose Blood-Debt Directive is level ≥ 2, and it is called from exactly two places: `burst.go:41` (`QueueCharTask(c.absorbDirectives, 22)`) and `charge.go:38` (`QueueCharTask(c.absorbDirectives, 12-windup)`). `cons.go:30-71` then queues the 9.00×ATK Pyro AoE at +50f behind a 10s `c2IcdKey`. ⚠️ gcsim implements ONLY the damage half — the +20% RES is not in the Go at all, so the kit text is the sole source for it. Retain — the absorb happens at `burst.go:41` and `charge.go:38` (both call `absorbDirectives`), the 10s ICD is `c2IcdKey`, gcsim models only the 9.00×ATK Pyro AoE and not the RES buff, C2's `initialDirectiveLevel = 2` (BoL economy) stays unauthored, and the 900% damage instance was dropped as a magnitude. ⚠️ The charged-attack source fires on EVERY CA, not only the absorbing one, and `procCooldown` is enforced only within a cast's own landings (`partitionCastPool`, buffWindows.ts:303-305) — not across separate CA blocks; consecutive CAs therefore open separate windows that `mergeRefreshedBars` fuses into one covered span, which is the right picture but not the 10s ICD. Two effects on the same host share no stat within one pool (`allElementalRes` ≠ `physicalRes`) and the two sources sit in different pools, so no dedupe collision. ⛔ Do not also author the damage half with an `application[]`: its Pyro Durability-25 `ICDTagNone` hit is real, but it fires on the absorb event, which has no trigger shape.

Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading by 3.

constellations.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other Henceforth..."
constellations.description: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, Balemoon Rising's CD will decrease by 2s and 15 Elemental Energy will be restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.
_curatorNotes: On-absorb effect: -2s burst CD + 15 energy per absorb event, 10s ICD (gcsim cons.go c4OnAbsorb, c4IcdKey). Likely trigger: `onAbsorbDirective`. Schema has no `cooldownReduction` effect type and no `addEnergy` effect type. Not authored.

constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Balemoon Rising by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together."
constellations.description:
The DMG of Balemoon Rising is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage.
For 20s after Arlecchino uses All Is Ash, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
_curatorNotes: ↻ RE-TRIGGERED 2026-09-17 (T1 tranche, `manual` retirement): `onCast skill`, 20s — gcsim `skill.go` queues `c6skill` at the skill's final hitmark, and `cons.go` grants CR 10% / CD 70% for 20s (`NewBaseWithHitlag(c6Key, 20*60)`) behind a 15s ICD, which her 30s skill cooldown never reaches. Before: zero windows of any kind at C6. (The 'value: 70' generator-error note was stale — the value has been 10 since the A6 pass — and is deleted.)

C6 buffs are restricted to AttackTagElementalBurst and AttackTagNormal in gcsim (cons.go c6skill switch). Schema may need a per-effect `ability` condition on the buff (similar to how some snapshottable buffs gate by ability tag). Not authored — current skeletons apply unconditionally to all damage.
C6 also adds FlatDmg to the burst hit: `c6Amount() = TotalAtk × 7.0 × (CurrentHPDebt / MaxHP)` at hitmark — scaling buff (BoL-runtime), not authored. Captured in burst _curatorNotes.

AUTHORED 2026-08-31: "1% All Elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK in excess of 1,000. The maximum RES increase she can gain this way FOR EACH is 20%." — two effects (allElementalRes + physicalRes), each capped at 20 SEPARATELY, not 20 shared. Was an `unknown` placeholder until `scaling.offset` existed. ⚓ ratio is VALUE PER 100 STAT UNITS (BuffValue JSDoc: contribution = (ratio/100) × stat), which is why a "per 1% ER" kit reads as ratio 40, not 0.4.
